about: Pledge to donate organs and tissue through the national Hayat programme.
note: Requirements read from the official Department of Health Abu Dhabi organ donation page on the checked date. Registration is a short online form, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Anyone in the UAE aged over 21 can pledge, whatever their nationality
documents: Emirates ID number, nationality and date of birth
Choice of emirate and consent to the terms
channels: Online registration through the 'Register Now' button on the DOH organ donation page
